# AgentActivity

AgentActivity is a private native macOS menu-bar application that turns Cursor,
Codex, Claude, and GitHub activity into a year-long calendar heatmap.

The application runs locally without accounts, advertising, analytics, or
telemetry upload. Cursor and Claude hooks retain privacy-minimized event metadata
without prompts, responses, commands, source code, credentials, or tool content.
GitHub activity is requested through the user's authenticated GitHub CLI session;
AgentActivity never reads or stores the GitHub token.

Requirements: macOS 13 Ventura or later. Release downloads are universal for
Apple silicon and Intel Macs and are hosted in the private GitHub repository.

Repository: https://github.com/adithyaakrishna/agent-activity
Releases: https://github.com/adithyaakrishna/agent-activity/releases/latest
